caption: A wheeled suitcase pulled from a smooth airport floor onto a cobblestone street starts bumping and rattling over the stones.

sa.check: A wheeled suitcase is pulled along a smooth airport floor.
It is pulled onto a cobblestone street.
It starts bumping and rattling over the stones.
The boundary between the smooth floor and the cobbles is visible.
The smooth rolling comes first and the bumping follows.

pc.expect: The case rolls smoothly on the flat floor and starts jolting where its wheels cross onto the cobbles.
pc.fail: The case bumps while still on the smooth floor; or it rolls over the cobbles as smoothly as it did on the floor; or the jolting begins well after the wheels are onto the stones.

pc.expect: Each jolt comes from a wheel riding up and off a stone, so the case lifts and drops with the stones it is passing over.
pc.fail: The case shakes without its wheels meeting any stone; or the cobbles flatten under the wheels as the case passes; or the case buzzes evenly like a machine with no relation to the stones beneath it.

pc.expect: The case comes back down onto the cobbles after each bump and its wheels stay on the ground.
pc.fail: The case stays up in the air between bumps; or it climbs steadily as it is pulled along; or it sinks into the cobbles.

pc.expect: The case follows the handle: it goes where the handle takes it and stops when the handle stops.
pc.fail: The case rolls on ahead of the handle with nothing pushing it; or it stops dead while the handle keeps moving forward; or it turns aside on the open street with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: One suitcase keeps its wheels, its handle and its shape.
pc.fail: The suitcase vanishes at the kerb or a second one appears; or a wheel comes away and the case rolls on as before; or the case passes through the cobbles.

pc.expect: The suitcase's colour, the cobbles and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The suitcase changes colour or size at the kerb; or the pattern of the cobbles changes between frames; or the buildings along the street rearrange.
